data.name: Munzir
data.gender_notes: Munzir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Munzir is an Arabic name for boys that means 'the victor', 'the conqueror'. It is an indirect Quranic name because it is derived from the N-Z-R root which is used in many places in the Quran. The name Munzir carries the meaning “The Victor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Munzir usually hope their child will grow to embody the victor and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munzir total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
